hero.title: New England Complex Systems Institute
hero.subtitle: At the New England Complex Systems Institute (NECSI), we offer certificate programs that equip learners with the tools to understand and navigate today’s most complex challenges using systems thinking and real-world application.

sections.text: New England Complex Systems Institute CERTIFICATE PROGRAMS At the New England Complex Systems Institute (NECSI), we offer certificate programs that equip learners with the tools to understand and navigate today’s most complex challenges using systems thinking and real-world application. Who It’s For Policymakers, scientists, educators, business leaders, students — anyone ready to work across disciplines and scale their impact. Enrollment Details • Year-round, rolling admission • Live & recorded sessions for flexible access • No prerequisites — open to all learners • Scholarships available based on merit and need Get Notified When Enrollment Opens
